ChangeRequest.title: ChangeRequest
ChangeRequest.description: A suggestion, addition, or change request submitted by a Quadra 12 visitor or student for review by the creator.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user.

authorName.description: Display name of the submitting user.

targetSection.description: Quadra 12 tab or section the suggestion applies to.

title.description: Short summary of the addition or change.

details.description: Detailed description of what should be added or changed.

status.description: Review lifecycle status controlled by the creator.

creatorNote.description: Optional response note from the creator.

SyncSession.title: SyncSession
SyncSession.description: Anonymous device-pairing study snapshot keyed by a 6-digit sync code for account-less cross-device cloud sync.

watchedLectureIds.description: List of watched 12th Hackers episode IDs (max 60).

bestScores.description: Map of best Examination Hall SQP scores per subject.

dailyChapterLog.description: Map of local YYYY-MM-DD dates to completed chapter ID arrays.

customBoardDate.description: Custom ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or empty for automatic Feb 16 rollover.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when sync code was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud sync push.

/changeRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores community additions and change requests readable by their author or the Quadra 12 creator admin.

/syncSessions/{syncCode}.description: Stores anonymous 6-digit study progress snapshots for QR and code-based device syncing without sign-in.
